summary: Friedberg argues Polymarket's dynamic market model is superior because it surfaces truth before the news does and may solve the insider arbitrage problem in gambling, making it the best model in the space.

summary: Chamath argues Google/Alphabet is a conglomerate whose intrinsic value far exceeds its trading value, creating pressure to spin off subsidiaries — a structural dynamic that will eventually force breakup or unlocking of value.
quote: The intrinsic value of everything they have will far exceed the actual value that it trades at. And so there'll always be these fissures of pressure...I suspect that this is going to happen at Google.
